Class Block

RawRenderLayer

The raw render layer number for this block. You should not rely on the specific values as they changed over the versions. You can use it to tell the game about a render layer OR see if it's different from another. This one is named raw in case we do want to have a proper stable enum for it in the future.

public int RawRenderLayer { get; }
